snippet.title: Sips and Sonnets - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Sips and Sonnets is a cozy game where you play as an elderly women who brews tea and writes poems for her clientele. 

Meet Ms. Meadows, some clients, and get a peek into their lives in this Sips and Sonnets release date trailer. Sips and Sonnets will be available on PC via Steam on September 12, 2025.

#Gametrailers #SipsAndSonnets #VisualNovel
